title: ARA Manifest Revision
description: One row of <ara>/manifest.history.jsonl. Records an append-only change to the manifest post-write (e.g. claim count updated after tex scan finishes). The current manifest.json always reflects the latest revision; a copy of every prior revision lives at <ara>/history/<manifest_hash>.json so audits can rewind.

revision.description: 1-indexed; the base manifest is revision 0 and lives in manifest.lock.

changed_fields.description: Dotted paths of top-level keys or nested paths that changed. Purely informational — the authoritative source is the diff between the two hashed payloads.

reason.description: Free-form note (e.g. 'claim_count updated after tex scan').

producer.description: Function or stage that made the change (e.g. 'update_manifest_claim_count').
